BL-1469 — A ticket whose deliverable the host gates by date (a mutation run under mutation_cooldown_days) has no machine-readable earliest promotion date, so prose in notes is all that stops the coordinator promoting it into a slot it cannot use - BL-1439 on 2026-09-05 froze the swarm at cap 1, BL-1468 was promoted 14:04Z on 2026-09-07 by the batch promotion after an approval sweep and demoted three minutes later; the promotion gates refuse a candidate before its not_before date on every path, queue-jump included
What it solves: Minted 2026-09-07 by the specifier on the coder's note, the same pass.
Landed with this mint (prose halves, BL-798): the `not_before` row in
backlog-schema.md and the coordinator prompt bullet; BL-1468 parked
under `status: blocked` + `not_before: 2026-09-10`.
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. What is FIRM: a ticket declaring not_before is never promoted before that UTC…
BL-1469 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1469" (or "reject BL-1469 <reason>") to act.
